The top cylinder has visible wear, scratches, and some discoloration on the paint.
The bottom cylinder is yellowish-orange and appears to be in better condition.
An orange gas hose is coiled around the top cylinder, with 'HIGH QUALITY ORIGINAL GAS' printed on it.
The cylinders appear to be used, with some dirt and scuff marks.
No brand or model markings are visible on the cylinders or hose in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Tokunbo gas cylinder' (imported used gas cylinder).
The photos are taken outdoors on a concrete surface, with cardboard boxes and metal frames in the background.
